textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 7 social-science · Geographical Diversity of India · Complete Summary
textbookBox.concept: The Peninsular Plateau is an old and stable landmass. It tilts a little to the east, so rivers like the Godavari, Krishna and Kaveri flow across it from west to east into the Bay of Bengal.
